`final class TextElement`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.text` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextElement.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/text/TextElement.java)

One styled part of a Text, with its value, its TextInfo and its own modifier.

## Description

Put several elements in one [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) to mix styles in one run, such as a bold word in a sentence.
The value can be any object, converted to a string by [`TextConverter`](/reference/text/textconverter/), or a `Supplier` read each time the text is measured or drawn.
